record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: For a rational polygon P, let c_*(P) and c^*(P) be the lower and upper quadratic growth constants governing the counting function f_P(ℓ) for periodic strips. Find effective estimates for c_*(P) and c^*(P).

evidence.quote: Задача 12. Найти эффективные оценки для c∗(P) и c∗(P).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P$ be a rational polygon, that is, a planar polygon all of whose interior angles are rational multiples of $\pi$. Consider the billiard flow inside $P$ (a point particle moving with unit speed and reflecting elastically off the boundary). A periodic billiard trajectory in $P$ that does not hit a corner belongs to a maximal strip of parallel periodic trajectories of the same length; call such a maximal family a periodic strip. For $\ell > 0$, let
$$f_P(\ell) = \#\{\text{periodic strips in } P \text{ whose trajectory length is at most } \ell\}.$$
It is known that for any rational polygon $P$ there exist constants $0 < c_*(P) \le c^*(P) < \infty$ and $\ell_0 > 0$ such that
$$c_*(P)\,\ell^2 \;\le\; f_P(\ell) \;\le\; c^*(P)\,\ell^2 \qquad \text{for all } \ell \ge \ell_0,$$
where $c_*(P)$ and $c^*(P)$ are taken to be, respectively, $\liminf_{\ell\to\infty} f_P(\ell)/\ell^2$ and $\limsup_{\ell\to\infty} f_P(\ell)/\ell^2$.

Problem. Provide effective estimates (explicit upper and lower bounds, computable in terms of the geometric data of $P$ such as its side lengths and angles) for the quadratic growth constants $c_*(P)$ and $c^*(P)$ that hold uniformly over all rational polygons $P$, or for natural subfamilies thereof.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact quadratic asymptotics of the counting function $f_P(\ell)$ are known only in special cases (Veech surfaces, regular polygons, certain lattice surfaces via Eskin–Masur–Zorich-type results). For general rational polygons, even the existence of the limit $\lim f_P(\ell)/\ell^2$ is unresolved, and no general effective estimates for $c_*(P)$ and $c^*(P)$ are available. The problem of giving effective bounds appears to remain open as of recent surveys on polygonal billiards.

status_evidence.title: Rational billiards and flat structures (Masur–Tabachnikov)
status_evidence.snippet: Quadratic upper and lower bounds c_*(P)ℓ^2 ≤ N(P,ℓ) ≤ c^*(P)ℓ^2 for rational polygons; exact asymptotics known only for Veech (lattice) surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: General effective values of the constants are not known.

status_evidence.title: Survey Lecture on Billiards (R. E. Schwartz)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses periodic orbits in rational polygons and the quadratic growth question, noting that explicit constants are computed only in lattice cases.
status_evidence.claim: Effective estimates for c_* and c^* in general remain open.

status_evidence.title: Growth rates for geometric complexities and counting functions in polygonal billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Studies growth rates of counting functions in polygonal billiards with partial results.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides only partial growth-rate information, not effective constants in general.
